fusions.name: Startled Burst
fusions.desc: Bursts a cloud of ink around you, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking each one back 2.5 tiles. You move 25% faster for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Trailing Whip
fusions.desc: Trails an arm behind you and whips it at an enemy up to 5 tiles away for 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Its damage rises 6% for every 100 paces you have covered since you last used it (max 30%).

fusions.name: Black Jet
fusions.desc: Jets you 6 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Flinch Cloud
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 40%, a shield worth 25% of your maximum health covers you for 4 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
